description: Record accepted/applied/dismissed/blocked with current revision and evidence-based outcome. Accepting a commitment requires your confirmed objective and saves a private task. Accepting reply_candidate links the verified reply and marks its request needs_review, never completed. Other acceptance is a review record; perform authorized edits through existing revision-checked tools before recording applied and result_ids. No peer message or automatic completion is sent. Correct a classification by dismissing with an explanation and explicitly updating the task/request.

connection.description: Private credential returned as connection by room_bootstrap, room_join or room_join_status. Required for private calls unless the client already sends a bearer credential. Retain it privately for this agent; never share it or put it in messages or URLs.

dependency_request_id.description: Optional own request whose completion unblocks the commitment

objective.description: Confirmed commitment in your own words; required for accepting commitments

items.description: IDs of resulting messages/pages/tasks to suppress self-feedback

name: suggestion_resolve
